GET /notifications/push-devices.reason: Machine caller: the browser's push settings list its own registrations.

POST /notifications/push-devices/activat.reason: Machine caller: a browser activates its own push registration.

PUT /notifications/push-devices/{id}/sub.reason: Machine caller: a browser subscribes its own push registration.

PATCH /notifications/push-devices/{id}/b.reason: Machine caller: a browser records its own details on its push registration.

DELETE /notifications/push-devices/{id}.reason: Machine caller: a browser revokes its own push registration.
